title: Two ex-Vol QBs have a good first preseason showings on Saturday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Two ex-Vol QBs have a good first preseason showings on Saturday
sources.description: It’s mid-August, and that means preseason NFL football is in full swing. A number of former Tennessee Vols are looking for jobs in the league, and among them are two quarterbacks in Joe Milton and Joey Aguilar. Milton was traded last offseason to the Dallas Cowboys, where he spent the 2025 season on the 53-man […]
